ratings_why.fun: A clear curve: small news early, Chimney and positioning in the middle, Gundel and the Rattenkönig turning the whole board into one growing body late; the reading load keeps it from an 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Gain that halves per step along the zigzag is a real positional puzzle, and Rats as glue for other tribes' growth plays unlike any current tribe.

verdict_why: The Thirty-Two can turn fight-only Speaker news into permanent stats each turn, a compounding loop worth one wording fix.

points.text: The Thirty-Two hears Speaker Brotkrume's Start of Combat Gossip and re-broadcasts it permanently next turn; with a Mill-Chimney and the Rattenkönig the biggest unit roughly triples each turn. Have it count only gains heard while recruiting.
"Last turn" doesn't say whether the fight is part of the turn, so a player can't tell what the Thirty-Two will repeat. State it.
Little Fips's +1/+1 never leaves him off an end; Gossip +2/+1 there would let the Tier 1 seed show spread from turn 1.
Wheel of Heads' end link barely matters on a full board; something that scales with Knot length would keep it worth a slot late.
Economy rests on one conditional gold; the Landlady paying per Hears with a higher cap would give Gossip boards a real econ turn in the mid game.

standouts.why: Mill-Chimney makes one slot the heart of the board; every placement choice runs through it.
Old Gundel is the moment the Knot comes alive, a clear Tier 5 direction card.
Taster Wendelin turns other tribes' growth into news, the tribe's best cross-tribe hook.

weakest.why: Wheel of Heads' link fades once the board is one Knot; it ends up a plain End of Turn Gossip.
Ratskeller Landlady is 1 conditional gold a turn on a 1/5 body.
Supper Committee costs a sale and gold for a once-a-turn Gossip; rarely the right line.

flags.note: With Speaker Brotkrume and a Mill-Chimney, fight news becomes permanent each turn and compounds; no counterplay once assembled.
Golden Rattenkönig doubling, Mill-Chimney doubling and a golden Gundel stack to about x8 on every unit, above the x4 ceiling.
Ilse repeating a Wendelin-off-Ooze or Thirty-Two Gossip doubles the tribe's biggest spikes.
Splitting each hit into shares multiplies Bristle and Damage Reduction; test against Bog folk.
